title: ATUS 2023 weighted respondent-diary population holdout

numerical_tolerances.sleep_episode_duration_quantile_mae: less than or equal to 30 minutes
numerical_tolerances.determinism: exact repeat for identical seed, occupant ID, and day index

known_deviations: The result is a U.S. population-prior validation, not deterministic or Italian-household truth.
Sleep location is inferred at home because BLS does not collect it; other missing-location minutes remain masked.
The empirical sampler preserves complete diary dependence but does not validate condition-dependent action probabilities or causal behavioral equations.
